notes.zh: 减少高斯查看器界面刷新与画布尺寸切换，优化精确深度排序，新增分阶段性能诊断。加载提示支持长文件名与独立进度条，高斯解析显示真实百分比。保留全部数据；同时提供完整 APK 与兼容热更新。
notes.en: Reduce Gaussian UI and canvas resize overhead, optimize exact depth sorting and add phase diagnostics. Loading cards wrap long filenames and show a separate activity bar or real parsing progress. Retain all data; provide a full APK and compatible web update.
